basics.name: Subhajit Chowdhury
basics.title: Cloud Data Engineer
basics.summary: Data Engineer with ~4 years of production experience building and owning end-to-end AWS data platforms for top-tier product organizations and GCC-ready enterprise teams. Engineered 150+ zero-loss serverless pipelines for distributed, remote-first teams using Delta Lake, DynamoDB, Glue, and Snowflake; delivered GBP 1.5M+ annualized infrastructure savings while maintaining sub-minute ingestion SLAs, audit-ready reliability, and AI-ready data products.

bullets: Engineered 150+ production-grade AWS ETL/ELT pipelines on S3, Glue, EMR, Redshift and Athena in a medallion architecture, powering global product teams with hundreds of GBs daily while enabling TB-scale refreshes and self-service analytics.
Standardized Delta Lake on S3 as the production storage layer, enabling ACID transactions, schema enforcement, and reliable upserts for high-volume CDC and audit-ready analytics.
Built metadata-driven ingestion with AWS Glue Crawlers for Parquet, JSON, and CSV sources, reducing downstream data onboarding latency by 30% and improving schema reliability for BI and analytics.

Orchestrated fault-tolerant Step Functions workflows with automated retry and error routing, cutting manual incident response and improving production reliability across batch and near-real-time workloads.
Developed incremental PySpark ETL pipelines with insert/update/delete support and dimensional modeling, keeping Redshift and downstream analytics tables current with minimal lag.
Implemented Git- and Jenkins-based CI/CD for repeatable deployment of ingestion, transformation, and analytics pipelines across dev/test/prod environments.
Delivered 20–25% query performance gains in Athena and Redshift through partition pruning, predicate pushdown, and optimized join design, reducing compute spend and query latency.
Enabled proactive production observability using CloudWatch dashboards, alerts, and log analysis to detect issues before downstream impact.
Reduced AWS compute and storage costs by optimizing S3 layout, file formats, and query scan patterns for Glue and Athena workloads.
Partnered with analytics, QA, and BI stakeholders across Agile delivery to align sprint execution with business SLAs and ensure reliable, outcome-driven data delivery.

Led AWS cloud lakehouse migration for SQL and MongoDB sources into S3 with Delta Lake, delivering £487K annual infrastructure savings while supporting product-grade analytics for distributed enterprise teams.
Defined medallion architecture with Delta Lake and AWS DMS ingestion, enabling ACID upserts, schema governance, and consistent incremental loads across the production data lake.
Built resilient Glue PySpark and Lambda transformations orchestrated by Step Functions, delivering retry-safe production pipelines with high availability.
Delivered fit-for-purpose data to 6 downstream systems—Athena, QuickSight, PostgreSQL, Redshift, Snowflake, and DynamoDB—ensuring each team received the right performance and cost profile.
Collaborated across Agile delivery with Jira, QA, analytics and BI stakeholders to align backlog priorities, validate data quality, and enable production readiness across UK/US/India teams.

experience.role: Data Engineer | Assistant System Engineer - Trainee
bullets: Spearheaded ETL modernization from Informatica PowerCenter to IICS, rebuilding legacy workflows into cloud-native orchestration and improving maintainability.
Developed end-to-end Oracle SQL extraction, validation and migration logic for OCI data warehousing, ensuring source-target consistency through automated testing.
Led on-premises Oracle to OCI database migration, managing cutover readiness and reconciliation to deliver a stable cloud analytics foundation.
Built and validated IICS ETL pipelines with data cleaning, unit testing and SIT execution to eliminate post-migration data issues.
Maintained disciplined version control and task tracking with GitHub and Jira across Agile delivery, ensuring transparency and stakeholder alignment.

projects.title: Near-Real-Time Serverless ELT Pipeline on AWS with Snowflake
bullets: Engineered a near-real-time event-driven data product with AWS EventBridge, DynamoDB Streams, Lambda, S3, and Snowflake — delivering product-grade latency and reliability for live analytics.

Solved continuous ingestion of semi-structured JSON by staging raw events in DynamoDB, transforming via Lambda, and landing processed records into S3 before Snowflake ingestion, enabling self-service analytics for downstream teams.
Automated continuous data loading from S3 into Snowflake using Snowpipe — eliminating batch dependency and enabling near-real-time product analytics.
Applied Snowflake SQL to build analytics-ready datasets and drive self-service reporting for product and business stakeholders.

projects.title: Serverless Batch Analytics ETL Pipeline on AWS
bullets: Designed and built a fully serverless batch analytics data product using Amazon S3, AWS Glue (PySpark), and Glue Crawlers — ingesting, processing, and structuring datasets for downstream reporting.
Architected a production medallion lake with raw and curated layers, enabling automated schema discovery, data quality enforcement, and reusable Spark transformations for product analytics.
Integrated AWS Glue Data Catalog with Amazon Athena and QuickSight to deliver self-service SQL analytics on S3 and executive-ready dashboards.

items: AWS (S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, Athena, Redshift, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, IAM, EventBridge)
